lastCompletedStory.title: Update planner and auditor templates to the cam/issue-<N> contract and re-embed vendor

nextStoryContext: US-002 done: templates/agents/subagent-planner.md and its .claude/ mirror now instruct the planner to emit 'branchName': 'cam/issue-<issueNumber>' (derived from the issue number) instead of the old 'cam/pr-<N>-<slug>' invented-slug format. templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md and its .claude/ mirror now check 14 (section E, Repo invariants) against the strict regex ^cam/issue-<N>$ (number only; no slug variant, no cam/<slug> no-issue fallback). Only the single branchName line in each of the 4 files was touched (per the dual-copy gotcha: .claude/ and templates/ copies are NOT byte-identical overall, so only the targeted line was edited in each, not a whole-file sync). src/vendor/_generated.ts was regenerated via 'bun run embed-vendor' and embed-vendor:check passes. This is a text/prompt-contract change only (no runtime TS logic touched), consistent with US-001 which did the code-side derivation (deriveBranchName in src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts, already returns 'cam/issue-<N>'). All PRD stories for CAM-236 (US-001, US-002) are now passes:true; if this was the last story, the next actor is /cam-review, not another implementer story. No further branchName-format work is known to remain in this PRD.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Story only edits agent-prompt markdown templates (planner/auditor) and regenerates the internal embedded-vendor bundle via cam-cli's own generate-embedded-vendor.ts script; no third-party library API was exercised or changed.
